race.comment: Looks another very good race for the in-form SHADHAVAR (6) who was a tough winner of the Regal Roller first up here. She'd won both starts impressively last time in and feels as if she's just hitting the peak of her powers now. Back to her own sex, Lane goes on from barrier one and she'll give a huge sight once more. WROTE TO ARATAKI (3) resumes. She was a strong winner over this route first up last time in and maps for every chance. Flies fresh and looks a danger. CUSTOM (11) was beaten at $1.75 last time off a dominant win here prior. Not well in at the set weights and penalties but is still improving. BELLE CHEVAL (1) resumes having last been seen winning the G1 Vinery Stud Stakes. That was over 2000m, she's won over shorter trips in NZ but 60kg fresh against some sharper ones will be an ask. PHOTOGRAPH (12) resumes. She struggles to win but can be running on.
